listing.name: KoroKoro Post nin — korokoro-recomp (elprogramadorloco-arch)
listing.summary: Upstream compares startup, menus, audio and stage 1 with DuckStation. Stages 2–10, memory-card saving and the ending remain unconfirmed. Portcove has not confirmed runtime behavior or gameplay. Follow the setup instructions below. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own Japanese SLPS-03479 CHD or CUE/BIN, with an 88131792-byte data track and MD5 6897e2c85262456a16c579a531435268. Keep your original files separately.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow run.bat with your own data to download hash-pinned portable tools, translate code and build out/KoroKoroPostNin.exe locally. The Android package is a separate route. Portcove does not install or prepare this source project automatically.
